findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_photo_poll" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_poll · Private data: create_photo_poll · Public sink: create_photo_poll.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_poll · Private data: create_photo_poll · Public sink: create_photo_poll

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
